verdict.rationale: LanceDB's first-party docs describe built-in BM25 keyword full-text search provided natively via Lance. Developers create an FTS index directly on a table column (`create_fts_index`), keep it current through reindexing, and can combine it with vector search for hybrid queries, so no external search engine is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of FTS quality and behavior.
